research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing standard and importance weighted conformal prediction under covariate shifts that preserved conditional response distributions.
Analyzed empirical coverage and interval width across shifted subgroups, examining sensitivity to density ratio estimation and calibration sample composition.

research.title: Probability Calibration in Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and isotonic regression across class imbalance conditions, using separate training, calibration, and evaluation partitions.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and class conditional calibration errors to distinguish changes in predictive discrimination from probability estimation.

research.title: Regularization and Feature Stability With Correlated Predictors
bullets: Designed simulation experiments varying predictor correlation and signal sparsity to compare ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression under matched evaluation conditions.
Analyzed prediction error and coefficient variability across repeated samples, examining how cross validation choices affected feature selection stability.

work.title: Data Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented validation checks for structured data imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate records within an existing application.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error messages to support troubleshooting of failed imports by application users.

projects.title: Kernel Regression and Predictive Uncertainty
bullets: Implemented Gaussian process and kernel ridge regression baselines, comparing predictive error under shared data splits and consistent hyperparameter search procedures.
Evaluated Gaussian process uncertainty on noisy regression data, examining interval coverage and sensitivity to kernel choice and noise assumptions.

projects.title: Mixture Models for Clustering With Unequal Variances
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models and compared clustering assignments with k means on synthetic data with unequal cluster variances.
Compared covariance parameterizations and initialization strategies using held out likelihood and assignment agreement, documenting convergence behavior and sensitivity to overlapping clusters.
